definitions:
T58 figures (rule A: real scene, graph, table) from agg/t58_summary.json + the recorded mp4 (600 frames = 1 per control row).
usage: fig_t58.py SUMMARY_JSON OUT_DIR   -> t58-scene.png / t58-clearance.png / t58-table.png + same-name .json sidecars
scene     : per episode: the placement (OFF run, t=0), OFF at its first robot-post MuJoCo contact row, ON at its first contact row
            (obstacle runs stop at the first contact, so the videos are shorter than 600 frames). Third-person front camera of the client recording (avoidance arrow overlay drawn by the client).
clearance : robot-to-post signed distance (certified GJK, cap 0.30 m) per control row; solid = run with the post, dashed = no-obstacle
            run with the same post placed virtually (the path the policy took without seeing it). <= 0 = penetration on the replayed kinematics.
table     : task success, grasp_t / place_t, HOLD chunks, robot-post contact rows (hand / other links, MuJoCo replay), max contact force,
            minimum clearance, non-target fruit contact rows.
